source.name: Potion-authored adversarial extraction (24 items, 8 fields each: distractor identifiers, superseded values, computed fields, absent-but-mentioned fields, order-inverted arrays, negated booleans; every string reference verified verbatim against its document and every computed number independently re-derived) | 1.1.0 (2026-08-26): exh-07 -> exh-07r — the blank closing balance collided with the not-stated-means-empty contract rule (no model in 28 ever fully passed); the key now says compute it.
